news.titleEn: U.S., Iran hold separate mediator talks as Mideast oil exports hit war-time high
news.conclusionEn: U.S. and Iranian officials held separate indirect talks with mediators to revive efforts to end the seven-month war, as Middle East crude exports climbed to their highest since the conflict began.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊分别与调停方间接会谈，重启结束七个月战争的努力
news.whyEn: Any path to reopening Hormuz would lower oil prices and ease the inflation pressure driving global bond selloffs.
news.whyZh: 若霍尔木兹海峡重开有望，油价和全球通胀压力都会明显缓解
news.detailEn: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York and said he expected Washington's reply by Tuesday. Iran's proposal asks the U.S. to release frozen funds, lift oil sanctions and end the naval blockade within days, with nuclear talks starting within a week. Trump called the plan "unacceptable" on Sunday. Oil prices eased on news of the talks, and regional crude exports have rebounded even without a deal.
news.detailZh: 伊朗外长阿拉格齐在纽约会见卡塔尔调停方，称预计美方周二前回复。伊朗方案要求美国在几天内解冻资金、解除石油制裁并结束对伊朗港口的海上封锁，一周内启动核谈判。特朗普周日称该方案「不可接受」。受谈判消息影响油价回落，而即便没有协议，中东原油出口也已反弹至战时高位。

news.titleEn: 30-year Treasury bond yield scales to highest level since 2002
news.conclusionEn: The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield topped 5.6% for the first time since 2002, rising for a sixth straight day.
news.conclusionZh: 美国30年期国债收益率突破5.6%，创2002年以来新高
news.whyEn: Higher long-term rates raise mortgage and corporate borrowing costs and weigh on stock valuations worldwide.
news.whyZh: 长期利率上升推高房贷和企业融资成本，压制全球股市估值
news.detailEn: The long bond has climbed amid a global government-debt selloff fueled by war-driven oil prices and inflation fears. Investors increasingly expect the Federal Reserve and other central banks to keep raising rates. Heavy corporate bond issuance has added to supply pressure. Stocks slipped modestly on Tuesday as yields hit new highs, and the next key tests are this week's GDP and jobs data.
news.detailZh: 受战争推高油价和通胀担忧影响，全球国债遭遇抛售，美国长债收益率持续攀升。投资者越来越押注美联储等央行将继续加息，企业债大量发行也加剧了供给压力。收益率创新高当天美股小幅下跌，本周的GDP和就业数据将是下一个关键考验。

news.conclusionEn: The Conference Board's consumer confidence index fell 6.7 points to 81.9 in September, its lowest level since 2014.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月消费者信心指数跌至81.9，为2014年以来最低
news.whyEn: Consumer spending drives about two-thirds of the U.S. economy, so souring sentiment raises recession risk.
news.whyZh: 消费约占美国经济三分之二，信心下滑意味着衰退风险上升
news.detailEn: The reading badly missed forecasts of about 89. Consumers' worries about fuel and other prices hit new highs, and the expectations index fell for a third straight month to 63.6, a level often associated with recession. The survey period included a Fed rate hike and ongoing Middle East tensions. Fewer households expect their incomes to rise in the coming months.
news.detailZh: 该数据远低于约89的预期。消费者对油价和物价的担忧创新高，预期指数连续第三个月下滑至63.6，这一水平通常与经济衰退相关联。调查期间正值美联储加息和中东局势紧张。预期未来收入上升的家庭比例也在减少。

news.titleEn: Anthropic IPO filing warns AI may pose 'existential risks to humanity'
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic's IPO prospectus devotes about 80 of 261 pages to risk factors, warning its AI could pose catastrophic or existential risks, as it eyes a valuation above $2 trillion.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic招股书用约三分之一篇幅警示AI或带来生存级风险
news.whyEn: It could be one of the largest IPOs ever and will set the benchmark for how public markets price frontier AI labs.
news.whyZh: 或成史上最大IPO之一，将决定公开市场如何给AI公司定价
news.detailEn: The prospectus describes rapid revenue growth alongside heavy losses and hundreds of billions of dollars in computing commitments. It also warns that AI models may show self-preserving behaviors such as resisting shutdown. Two customers reportedly account for nearly a quarter of revenue. The listing is expected after the U.S. midterm elections in November.
news.detailZh: 招股书显示公司收入高速增长，但同时亏损巨大，并承诺数千亿美元的算力支出。文件还警告AI模型可能出现抗拒关机等「自我保护」行为。据报道两大客户贡献了近四分之一收入。上市预计在11月美国中期选举之后进行。

news.titleEn: China factory activity snaps 2-month contractionary streak
news.conclusionEn: China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 50.1 in September from 49.8, returning to expansion, while the services PMI jumped to 50.2.
news.conclusionZh: 中国9月官方制造业PMI回升至50.1，重回扩张区间
news.whyEn: It signals stabilization in the world's second-largest economy and supports demand for commodities and Asian exports.
news.whyZh: 显示全球第二大经济体企稳，利好大宗商品和亚洲出口
news.detailEn: Growth was led by equipment and high-tech manufacturing, helped by the global AI hardware boom. The non-manufacturing PMI beat expectations by rising to 50.2 from 49.0. Weak domestic consumption and higher energy costs from the Middle East war still weigh on margins. Trading partners are also pushing back on China's excess manufacturing capacity ahead of the October Golden Week holiday.
news.detailZh: 增长主要由装备制造和高技术制造带动，受益于全球AI硬件热潮。非制造业PMI从49.0升至50.2，好于预期。不过内需疲弱以及中东战争推高的能源成本仍在压缩企业利润，贸易伙伴对中国产能过剩的不满也在上升。国庆长假前夕公布的这组数据提振了市场信心。

news.titleEn: Trump Rejects New AI Safety Laws After Meeting Industry Titans
news.conclusionEn: After a White House lunch with Nvidia, Anthropic and other tech CEOs, Trump rejected new federal AI safety laws, saying existing law enforcement and self-regulation are enough.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普会见科技巨头后拒绝出台新的联邦AI安全法规
news.whyEn: It keeps U.S. AI development largely unregulated, supporting chip and AI stocks but leaving safety to voluntary pledges.
news.whyZh: 美国AI发展基本维持宽松监管，利好芯片股，安全靠自律
news.detailEn: Nearly two dozen executives attended, including Anthropic's Dario Amodei and Nvidia's Jensen Huang. Participants signed a voluntary accord that Trump called "morally binding." Trump argued the U.S. cannot slow down if it wants to stay ahead of China. The stance follows his rejection of international AI regulation at the UN General Assembly last week.
news.detailZh: 近二十位高管出席，包括Anthropic的阿莫代伊和英伟达的黄仁勋。与会者签署了一份自愿协议，特朗普称其具有「道德约束力」。他表示美国若想保持对中国的领先，就不能放慢速度。此前一周他已在联合国大会上拒绝国际AI监管。

news.titleEn: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Live updates and announcements
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI launched Dots, always-on autonomous agents with their own cloud computers, plus a new Pro tier, and confirmed early talks on a new funding round.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI发布常驻型AI代理Dots，并确认洽谈新一轮融资
news.whyEn: The AI agent race is intensifying among OpenAI, Meta and others, and a new raise shows capital needs keep rising.
news.whyZh: AI代理竞争白热化，新融资显示头部AI公司资金需求持续膨胀
news.detailEn: Each Dot runs on OpenAI's latest model with its own browser and cloud computer, working on user-assigned goals around the clock and connecting to thousands of apps. It rolls out to Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise users. The move directly challenges Meta's popular Muse agent. OpenAI is reportedly discussing a raise of around $30 billion after its $122 billion round in March.
news.detailZh: 每个Dot都运行在OpenAI最新模型上，拥有独立的浏览器和云端电脑，可全天候执行用户设定的目标，并连接数千款应用。该功能面向Pro、Business Premium和企业用户推出，直接对标Meta热门的Muse代理。据报道，继3月完成1220亿美元融资后，OpenAI正洽谈约300亿美元的新融资。

news.titleEn: US Forces Exit Iraq After Two Decades, Leaving Opening for Iran
news.conclusionEn: U.S. forces are leaving their last bases in Iraq by Sept. 30, ending a 23-year military presence under a 2024 agreement.
news.conclusionZh: 美军9月30日前撤离伊拉克最后基地，结束23年驻军
news.whyEn: The exit may expand Iran's regional influence and give Islamic State room to regroup amid the ongoing U.S.-Iran war.
news.whyZh: 撤军或扩大伊朗地区影响力，并给「伊斯兰国」重组空间
news.detailEn: The withdrawal was agreed under President Biden in 2024 and carried out by the Trump administration even as it wages war on Iran. Iran and its allies are celebrating the departure as a victory. Iraqi security analysts warn that Iran-aligned armed groups could gain free rein. Kurdish commanders report increased movement by Islamic State sleeper cells.
news.detailZh: 这次撤军是拜登政府2024年与伊拉克达成的协议，由正与伊朗交战的特朗普政府执行。伊朗及其盟友将美军撤离视为胜利。伊拉克安全分析人士警告，亲伊朗武装可能不受制约，库尔德指挥官也称「伊斯兰国」潜伏人员活动增多。

news.titleEn: Trump Accounts will auto-enroll children, potentially adding 60 million
news.conclusionEn: The Treasury will begin auto-enrolling children under 18 into tax-deferred Trump Accounts as early as Oct. 1, potentially adding more than 60 million accounts.
news.conclusionZh: 美财政部10月起为儿童自动开设「特朗普账户」，或新增6000万个
news.whyEn: It creates a new mass investing vehicle for U.S. families and a large new flow of long-term assets to brokers and fund managers.
news.whyZh: 为美国家庭提供新的长期投资工具，也带来大量资管资金流
news.detailEn: Accounts will be opened for every child with a Social Security number and no existing account. Kids born between 2025 and 2028 are eligible for a one-time $1,000 Treasury deposit. Parents must still claim the account and request the deposit before contributing. Future years could see about 2 million new accounts annually.
news.detailZh: 凡有社保号且尚无账户的未成年人都会被自动开户。2025至2028年出生的孩子可获得财政部一次性1000美元存款，但家长仍需认领账户并申请这笔钱后才能存入资金。此后每年预计新增约200万个账户。

news.titleEn: Israel kills senior Hamas commander in Gaza strike
news.conclusionEn: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza City killed Izz al-Din al-Beik, commander of Hamas' armed wing in northern Gaza.
news.conclusionZh: 以色列空袭击毙哈马斯加沙北部武装派别指挥官
news.whyEn: It is the third top Hamas commander killed in recent weeks, raising the risk of renewed escalation in Gaza.
news.whyZh: 这是数周内第三名被击毙的哈马斯高层，加沙局势恐再升级
news.detailEn: Al-Beik was killed in a strike on an apartment building in Gaza City early Tuesday. Hamas described him as a leader of the October 7, 2023 attack. Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz accused him of planning attacks and recruiting militants to rebuild Hamas forces. The strike adds to regional tensions already heightened by the U.S.-Iran war.
news.detailZh: 贝克周二凌晨在加沙城一栋公寓楼遭空袭身亡。哈马斯称他是2023年10月7日袭击的领导者之一。内塔尼亚胡和国防部长卡茨指控他策划袭击并招募武装人员重建哈马斯力量。此次空袭进一步加剧了本已因美伊战争而紧张的地区局势。

businessTips.explanationEn: Switching costs are the money, time, effort or risk a customer faces when moving from one product to a competitor. High switching costs make customers stickier and give a business pricing power. They can come from data lock-in, integrations, learning curves or contracts. Strong businesses build switching costs by becoming deeply embedded in customers' workflows.
businessTips.explanationZh: 转换成本是指客户从一个产品换到竞争对手时需要付出的金钱、时间、精力或风险。转换成本越高，客户黏性越强，企业定价权也越大。它可能来自数据锁定、系统集成、学习成本或合同约束。优秀的企业会通过深度嵌入客户的工作流程来构建转换成本。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company that runs payroll, accounting and HR on one software suite rarely switches, because migrating years of data and retraining staff is painful. That's why such vendors can raise prices modestly each year with low churn.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司如果把工资、财务和人事都放在同一套软件上，就很少会更换，因为迁移多年数据和重新培训员工太麻烦。所以这类软件商每年小幅涨价，客户流失率依然很低。

businessTips.explanationEn: Churn rate is the percentage of customers or subscribers who cancel within a given period. For subscription side businesses, reducing churn is often cheaper than acquiring new customers. Even a small monthly churn compounds: 5% monthly churn means losing roughly 46% of customers in a year. Tracking why people leave reveals what to fix first.
businessTips.explanationZh: 流失率是指在一定时期内取消订阅或不再购买的客户比例。对订阅型副业来说，降低流失往往比获取新客户更便宜。即使每月流失率很小，也会复利放大：每月5%的流失意味着一年流失约46%的客户。追踪客户离开的原因，能帮你找到最该优先改进的地方。
businessTips.exampleEn: A newsletter creator with 1,000 paying readers sends a short exit survey to everyone who cancels. Learning that most leave because posts are too long, they add a summary section and cut monthly churn from 6% to 3%.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位拥有1000名付费读者的newsletter作者，给每个退订的人发一份简短问卷。发现多数人因为文章太长而离开后，他加入了摘要板块，把月流失率从6%降到了3%。

businessTips.explanationEn: A lock-up period is a contractual window, typically 90 to 180 days after an IPO, during which insiders and early investors cannot sell their shares. It prevents a flood of selling right after listing. When the lock-up expires, a large number of shares can suddenly become tradable. This often puts pressure on the stock price around the expiry date.
businessTips.explanationZh: 锁定期是IPO后通常90至180天的合同约定期，期间公司内部人士和早期投资者不能卖出股票，目的是防止上市后立刻出现大量抛售。锁定期结束时，大量股票突然可以流通，往往会在到期前后对股价形成压力。
businessTips.exampleEn: With mega-IPOs like Anthropic's on the horizon, investors should check the prospectus for lock-up terms. If employees and venture funds hold most shares, the stock may be volatile when their lock-up ends months after listing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 随着Anthropic等超大型IPO临近，投资者应在招股书中查看锁定期条款。如果员工和风投持有大部分股份，那么在上市几个月后锁定期结束时，股价可能出现较大波动。
